content:
toni: Quick heads-up: starting qv1b-int4 bring-up tomorrow AM. goal: small, high-signal promptset to catch quant-specific formatting and tokenization regressions.
mei: What's the target for the golden? and do we include existing anchors?
toni: golden ~700, review pool ~1300. reuse ~200 anchors but add new long-tail locales and code-mixed samples.
rahul: Suggest semantic_dedupe=0.82 (embed tok-v3) and exact_token_overlap=0.94. For small-string prefixes related to kvcache, use a weaker exact threshold so we don't drop variants.
jess: please include ~120 adversarial formatting cases (malformed markdown, nested yaml/json, table-looking ascii). those trigger parsing hallucinations in int4.
labelops-bot: LabelOps availability: 1.5k/day with double-review policy. Reserve?
toni: yes reserve. workflow = sample -> normalize -> dedupe -> flag synthetic -> triage -> double-label gold -> adjudicate. owner: mei.
mei: I'll own adjudication. timeline: start 09:00 UTC, 60h window. escalate to toni if disagreement > 18%.
rahul: also include 60 very long sequences (>=1500 tokens) to stress kv cache and int4 attention kernels.
jess: add tokenizer-variant checks (bpe vs unigram) and record token-level diffs in eval. small diffs caused false positives.
eval-bot: suggested sampling config:
```
mode: focused_longtail
locales: ["id","pt_BR","ko","ru","en-IN"]
min_tokens: 20
max_tokens: 1800
semantic_dedupe: 0.82
exact_dedupe: 0.94
adversarial_count: 120
long_seq_count: 60
golden_count: 700
labelpool_count: 1300
exclude_lists: ["holdout_main_2025","canary_qv1b_seed"]
embed_model: tok-v3-embed
normalization: nfkc+strip_ws
```
toni: perfect. please upload normalized candidates to s3://curation/qv1b/int4-2025-05 and attach provenance JSON.
labelops-bot: Golden review policy: double-review; if reviewer disagreement >=15% send to adjudicator; if >=30% escalate to owner. Slots reserved starting 09:00 UTC.
mei: will create a small adjudication rubric (clarity, factuality, format-preserve). will share link when ready.
rahul: for eval harness, run BLEU/ROUGE + crit-rate + tokenizer_delta + perplexity. run side-by-side vs qv1b-fp16 and qv1b-int8.
eval-bot: eval command snippet:
```
./scripts/run_smoke --models qv1b-fp16,qv1b-int8,qv1b-int4 --dataset s3://curation/qv1b/int4-2025-05/micro-golden.json --metrics crit_rate,bleu,rouge,tokenizer_delta,perplexity --out /tmp/qv1b-smoke
```
jess: can we also surface per-locale crit-rate deltas and token-boundary failure cases? those were most actionable last cycle.
toni: yes. add per-locale breakdown and token-boundary examples to the smoke report.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-05-10T07:00:00Z -> qv1b-int4 on staging-dedicated. Notifying #eng-runtime and #eng-sre.
rahul: one more: run the quant-bias-check suite (checks for systematic replacement of named entities and numeric mangling). small but consistent issues popped in earlier int4s.
mei: noted. I'll add quant-bias-check to the harness.
toni: final checklist: sampling config posted, normalized upload path, dedupe lists, labelops reserved, adjudication rubric, harness wired, canary scheduled. If no blockers we start tomorrow. :rocket: 
labelops-bot: Ack. All set.
